max_bytes.description: The declared ceiling this run ran under, over both directions summed. Absent means the aperture was declared without one (ADR 0014).

oneOf.description: Every aperture of a start that named apertures, in the order listed (design 26 section 2). A start that named one aperture reports the single object instead.

max_bytes.description: The declared ceiling this run ran under, over both directions summed. Absent means the aperture was declared without one (ADR 0014).

listen.description: The loopback address and port the forwarder listened on in the run's namespace: the n-th listed aperture on 127.0.0.n.

applied-network.title: applied network: the floor, the aperture that was installed, or every aperture of a list

exec-refusal.description: Why this run ended without its program's own answer: the named bound that ended it, or a working directory that was no longer there when the sandbox was built (design 26 section 1). No address in either case.

io_read_bytes.description: Present exactly when the binding capability snapshot publishes exec.resource-usage.block_io true; absent, never zero, otherwise (ADR 0032).

io_write_bytes.description: Present exactly when the binding capability snapshot publishes exec.resource-usage.block_io true; absent, never zero, otherwise (ADR 0032).

process.description: One host-process record (ADR 0036 S1 to S4, S6 and S11). Unconfined, and every record says so. An observation the daemon could not make is absent, never zero; an ended record has no cgroup and carries none. Environment values are never on a record.

process-cpu.description: Cumulative CPU from the cgroup's cpu.stat usage_usec.

process-deadline.description: The effective hard deadline as one absolute instant, and which start field set it (S11).

process-exit.description: The main process's exit, as a code or as the terminating signal, never both (S3).

process-lease.description: A TTL lease (ttl_ms, renew_by, state) or keep with its own reason, never both (S4).

process-listening.description: The TCP and UDP sockets in a listening state whose inodes a member of the cgroup holds, observed at listing time.

process-log-line.description: One retained line without its newline. Bytes that are not UTF-8 are replaced and lossy is true; a line longer than the bound is kept cut at it, truncated, with full_bytes its written length, and never split.

process-log-tail.description: A bounded tail of one record's log (S7). discarded_bytes is what the log bound has discarded since the log was created; the header repeats the record's profile and confinement.

process-memory.description: The cgroup's memory.current, page cache included; named for what it is, not RSS.

process-owner.description: The owner session and name, labels beneath the subject that grant no authority.
